Rulings.Tengu:
● The effect of "The Fabled Unicore" is a continuous effect.
● The effect checks hand size at resolution. If Player A has 5 cards in hand and Player B has 4 cards in hand, and Player A activates the effect of "Effect Veiler", it will be negated.
● If Player A has 4 cards in hand and Player B has 4 cards in hand, and Player A activates the effect of "Effect Veiler", it will not be negated.
● This effect can negate Counter Trap cards, as long as it was already face-up on the field before the activation.
● The effect will negate cards that activate in the Main Deck, Extra Deck, or Banishment, but will not destroy them.
